title: Handout 4 Stage 4A full-corpus WHAT x WHEN design and corpus audit
note: Design/corpus audit only. The live 21-session NWB catalog was inspected through bytes-aware HDF5 event and signal metadata reads; no neural tensor, estimator, permutation draw, or model was created.

claims.statement: Stage 4A audited 21 sessions across 3 subjects and 8,286 correct omission rows derived from stimulus_number=2 trial anchors and canonical condition ontology. All audited sessions exposed raw LFP and MUAe acquisition groups and units metadata.

The existing W1 p2+p3 to p4 confirmatory corpus remains the frozen five-session set across three subjects. A separate common-cycle extension supports 16 sessions in design-only geometry but is explicitly exploratory and is not promoted to the confirmatory estimand.

Under the audited common-cycle geometry, W2 predictable-versus-random context supports 15 sessions at each of p2, p3, and p4; W3 family classification supports 15, 16, and 15 sessions at p2, p3, and p4; T1 all-family position supports 19 sessions; A-only, B-only, and R-only position support 14, 16, and 16 sessions; cross-family A-to-B and B-to-A position generalization support 5 and 4 sessions.

Raw LFP metadata is present across the audited sessions, while LFP TFR readiness cannot be trusted from the current readiness table: the resolved live TFR directory contains 4 files whereas readiness reports 792. Raw MUAe groups are present, but no first-class MUAe loader exists, so MUAe has zero training-ready corpus rows in this stage.

The audit specifies local omission alignment from the p1 anchor using canonical offsets p2=1031 ms, p3=2062 ms, and p4=3093 ms, and prohibits absolute p1-relative timestamps and raw condition codes as classifier features. Tensor-level alignment has not yet been validated because Stage 4A performs no feature extraction.

issues: The live readiness table is stale relative to the resolved TFR directory and must be reconciled before any TFR-backed LFP training.
MUAe has raw acquisition groups but no first-class loader or preprocessing contract; no MUAe linear model is authorized.
The larger W1 common-cycle extension is not the frozen signed confirmatory corpus and must not replace it without a scientific amendment.
W2 context and W3 family labels are deterministically tied to sequence_family; they support context/family information questions, not omitted-stimulus identity claims.
Local omission-relative alignment is a design contract only until a Stage 4B feature implementation validates signal timebases and coordinates.
SAFE_TO_RUN_NEW_LINEAR_MODELS, SAFE_TO_RUN_M2, and SAFE_TO_RUN_M3_M4 remain NO.

verification.verdict: stage4a_complete; stop before new linear training and require separate Stage 4B authorization

falsifier: This audit is superseded if the live catalog/readiness/TFR inputs change, the canonical condition or timing ontology changes, the TFR path discrepancy is resolved by a new receipt, or a signed Handout 4 amendment changes the task estimands.
